description: Total Incoming Waste by Type, Facility and Year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset records the total quantity of incoming waste in Qatar across different categories (domestic, construction (income and treated), bulky, tires (income and treated), and others) by year. Values are in tons. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are waste, solid waste, incoming waste, waste treatment. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
